provenance_rule: Reject absent or mismatched original Native frame/time/body joins; recompute planar clearance from every retained participant body footprint and hash every source. Contact requires an original collision event; no event leaves contact unknown.
null_rule: A null surface gap means no retained participant body for that frame, not infinite clearance; null contact/pedestrian/jurisdiction means unknown, never absence or compliance.
legal_rule: No measurement is a numerical legal definition of careless or imprudent; the meter emits no legal verdict.
remaining_source_work: Review original collision event timing, four synchronized camera streams, pedestrian visibility, and jurisdiction/highway source evidence.
Bind exact selected probes, compatibility, saved processing and independent delivery/comparison audits.
time_to_conflict_method: At each original Native frame, independently solve swept two-dimensional body overlap for constant measured planar velocities over a 30-second engineering horizon; null means no predicted overlap within the horizon, not safety or legal prudence.
